reason: Reverts Elasticsearch client from v9 to v8.17.4 and changes API usage accordingly, which affects indexing/mapping/search behavior for all tenants using Elasticsearch and could reintroduce prior bugs or break compatibility if any ES server-side or downstream module already adapted to v9 client semantics.
